shared_elements: low-relief carving on a vertical, roughly rectangular field
beaked/animal-head forms in profile projecting near the top edge
row of rounded, lobed shapes along the upper margin
horizontal band(s) of repeating geometric (zigzag/hatched) ornament
tiered/registered organisation from top to bottom
justification: The most specific correspondence is the upper zone in both: a row of rounded lobed elements paired with outward-facing beaked heads, above a band of hatched geometric ornament, within a vertical relief panel of similar ochre tone. Against this, A is a weathered photographic stone monument built from stacked horizontal registers of separate animals, whereas B is a clean schematic drawing of a single bilaterally symmetrical frontal anthropomorph with costume detail, so the underlying compositional logic and the manner of rendering are quite different.
